# Tool target

Read by `spec/cogiteer/commands/tools_spec.cr` through `read_text_file`.

**Do not edit this file.** Its contents become part of the tool result, which
becomes part of the next request's body, which is what Wiretap digests. Change
a word here and the tool transcripts stop replaying and re-record instead.

The marker line the spec looks for: PARSNIP-4417.
